summary: This resolution commemorates the lives of the six U.S. Airmen and five civilian contractors who died in the TORQE 62 plane crash in Afghanistan on October 2, 2015, extends condolences to their families, and expresses gratitude for their service.

scores.thoughts: This resolution commemorates the lives of military service members and civilian contractors who died in a C-130J crash during Operation Freedom’s Sentinel. While it acknowledges military service and sacrifice, it does not propose any changes to military spending or policy; its focus is purely commemorative.
